sentences.text: Schemes for welfare of School Children belonging to BPL and BC(A) families: Monthly Stipend for BPL Students

**Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from BPL students to support their education. Under this scheme, a monthly stipend is provided to students studying in classes 1 to 12 in Haryana Government schools.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: Scholarships and student finance

**Detailed Description:** The scheme &quot;Schemes for Welfare of School Children Belonging to BPL and BC(A) families: Monthly Stipend for BPL Students&quot; was launched by the Government of Haryana during the financial year 2009-10. It aims to provide financial assistance to students from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families to support their education. Under this scheme, a monthly stipend is provided to students from BPL families studying in classes 1 to 12 in Haryana Government schools.

**Benefits / Assistance:** **A. For Girl Students:** 1. Class 1 to 5: ₹150/- per month 1. Class 6 to 8: ₹200/- per month 1. Class 9 to 12: ₹300/- per month 1. Class 11 to 12 **(Science Students only)**: ₹400/- per month **A. For Boy Students:** 1. Class 1 to 5: ₹75/- per month 1. Class 6 to 8: ₹100/- per month 1. Class 9 to 12: ₹150/- per month 1. Class 11 to 12 **(Science Students only)**: ₹200/- per month > **Mode of Disbursement:** > Direct transfer to students' bank accounts. > **Frequency of Disbursement:** > Monthly basis. > **Expected Time of Disbursement:** > Funds to be transferred at the beginning of each quarter. > **Validity:** > Applicable for the duration of the academic session. > Attendance criteria: Minimum 50% attendance required for next installment
**Exclusions / Not eligible:** 1. The applicant who does not maintain 50% attendance will not receive the next instalment. 1. The applicant not studying in a Haryana Government school is ineligible.

**Application Process:** - The applicant should contact their respective school authorities. > For any queries, applicants can contact the school administration or visit the official website of the Education Department, Government of Haryana.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: School Education Department, Haryana; Nodal Department: School Education Department
